create.name: Judith Hanson Lasater
create.bio:
Judith Hanson Lasater began teaching yoga in 1971 and is best known for shaping Restorative Yoga, the practice of resting in supported poses with blankets, bolsters and long stillness. She is also a physical therapist with a doctorate, and her teaching brings anatomy and the way the body moves together with yoga philosophy. Her Relax and Renew trainings prepare other teachers to offer Restorative Yoga, and she has taught across six continents and in nearly every US state.

Her written work runs from the body to everyday ethics. Living Your Yoga and A Year of Living Your Yoga draw on the Yoga Sutra and the Bhagavad Gita for daily life; Yogabody and Yoga Myths look closely at anatomy and at common habits of practice; and What We Say Matters, written with Ike K. Lasater, pairs Nonviolent Communication with yogic and Buddhist teaching on speech. Her twelfth book, Savasana: The Practice of Radical Rest, was co-written with her daughter Lizzie Lasater, who works with her on their online school, lasater.yoga. She still teaches in person at studios and retreat centres, including Kripalu, and online through a yearlong training and monthly calls for teachers.

books.title: Living Your Yoga: Finding the Spiritual in Everyday Life
books.author: Judith Hanson Lasater
books.description: Her book on carrying yoga off the mat, now in a second edition. It takes ideas from the Yoga Sutra and the Bhagavad Gita and applies them to ordinary days.

books.title: A Year of Living Your Yoga: Daily Practices to Shape Your Life
books.author: Judith Hanson Lasater
books.description: A short reflection for each day of the year, each with a small practice to try. It is meant to be read one page at a time.

books.title: Savasana: The Practice of Radical Rest
books.author: Judith Hanson Lasater and Lizzie Lasater
books.description: Written with her daughter Lizzie, this book treats the final resting pose of a yoga class as a complete practice of its own. Shambhala publishes it on 24 November 2026.

books.title: What We Say Matters: Practicing Nonviolent Communication
books.author: Judith Hanson Lasater and Ike K. Lasater
books.description: Written with Ike K. Lasater, it brings Nonviolent Communication together with yogic and Buddhist teaching on truthful, kind speech. It offers practices for talking and listening at home and at work.

books.title: Yogabody: Anatomy, Kinesiology, and Asana
books.author: Judith Hanson Lasater
books.description: A study of how the body is built and how it moves, written for yoga students and teachers. It draws on her training as a physical therapist.

books.title: Teaching Yoga with Intention: The Essential Guide to Skillful Hands-On Assists and Verbal Communication
books.author: Judith Hanson Lasater
books.description: A guide for teachers on how they speak to students and when and how they use touch. It looks at clear instruction and at the relationship in the room.

books.title: Yoga Myths: What You Need to Learn and Unlearn for a Safe and Healthy Yoga Practice
books.author: Judith Hanson Lasater
books.description: She examines eleven common beliefs about yoga poses and practice that she thinks are mistaken. Each chapter explains the body's mechanics and suggests a different approach.

courses.title: Living Your Yoga: Finding the Spiritual in Everyday Life (New Orleans)
courses.description: A three-day workshop in New Orleans on bringing the ideas of yoga into daily life. Booking is through the host studio linked from her calendar.

courses.title: Savasana Book Signing and Restorative Yoga Class (Santa Rosa)
courses.description: An afternoon Restorative Yoga class in Santa Rosa, California, marking the release of her book Savasana, with a book signing. Booking is through the host studio.

courses.title: Compassion in Practice: Movement and Speaking with Presence (Santa Rosa)
courses.description: A four-day workshop in Santa Rosa, California, joining yoga practice with attention to how we speak and listen. Booking is through the host studio.

courses.title: Living Your Yoga: A Retreat in Italy
courses.description: A week-long yoga retreat in Salento, Puglia, in southern Italy. Booking is through the retreat venue linked from her calendar.

courses.title: Relax and Renew Restorative Yoga Training Level 2 (San Francisco)
courses.description: The second level of her Relax and Renew training for teachers of Restorative Yoga, held in person in San Francisco. Booking is through the host studio.

courses.title: Relax and Renew Restorative Yoga Training Level 1 (San Francisco)
courses.description: The first level of her Relax and Renew training in Restorative Yoga, five days in person in San Francisco. Booking is through the host studio.

courses.title: One True Thing: The Practice of Deep Self Inquiry (Feathered Pipe Ranch, Montana)
courses.description: A week-long residential retreat at Feathered Pipe Ranch in Montana on self-inquiry through yoga. Booking is through the ranch.

courses.title: Office Hours: Monthly Conversations for Yoga Teachers
courses.description: A monthly one-hour Zoom call for yoga teachers with Judith and Lizzie Lasater, with replays and notes. Past themes include sequencing, ethics in teaching, pranayama and meditation, and home practice.
